subject: HANDOFF: Artifactory NG lease event reducer — 5 hazards reproduced, revised model 12/12 PASS
body: Artifactory NG reducer sublane complete and released. After overlap reconciliation, scope was narrowed from broad production CAS/backend selection to append-only PrimarySingletonLease event-folding and current-fence validation. Cycle 1 reproduced five structural hazards in bundled Research V5 shadow_runtime.py: RELEASE ignored, SUPERSEDE ignored, stale cached lease still verifies after newer epoch, lease_until expiry ignored, and pre-convergence same-epoch writers can each locally see UNIQUE_ACTIVE. Cycle 2 reference reducer adds exact causal tombstones, explicit expiry, backend-accepted event gating, same-identity renew chains, top-epoch conflict semantics, and validates the current folded winner including forum/permission refs; 12/12 adversarial tests PASS. Manager recommendation: keep atomic lease issuance/backend selection separate from immutable audit-log folding; require backend acceptance receipt on authoritative CLAIM/RENEW and enforce fencing at every privileged sink. Peer live-Library evidence that overwrite=false auto-renames collisions strengthens the conclusion that Library file publication alone is not a linearizable allocator. This is READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW for reducer/schema semantics only, with no production write. New Primary P0 field regression now outranks routine Artifactory work; agent releases this lane and pivots to an unclaimed P0 lane after this durable handoff.
